name: fmcg-sellout-dashboard
description: Store-level sell-out and distribution dashboard connector: coverage, active stores, on-shelf availability, display execution and visit frequency.

display.name: 门店动销看板
display.description_zh: 接入门店动销看板，查询门店覆盖、活跃门店、有货率、陈列执行与拜访频次，按区域、渠道、门店类型拆解动销表现。
display.description_en: Connect to the store sell-out dashboard for coverage, active stores, on-shelf availability, display execution and visit frequency, sliced by region, channel and store type.
examples_zh: 看看本月各区域的门店覆盖率和活跃门店数
列出陈列执行不合格的门店
对比现代渠道和传统渠道的单店产出
examples_en: Show store coverage and active store counts by region this month
Which stores dropped below 90% on-shelf availability
Compare sales per store between modern and traditional trade
